Episode details

Celtic maintained their four-point lead at the top of the Premiership with a hard-fought victory over Hibs, while Hearts bounced back from a difficult week with an important win against Motherwell. Stevie Miller is joined by Kevin Thomson and Conor Sammon to analyse Celtic's performance, discuss the struggles of big-money striker Kasper Høgh and assess whether there are signs of progress at Easter Road despite another defeat for Hibs. The panel also looks at Hearts' encouraging response under Wouter Vrancken, Rangers' impressive attacking form, Dundee United's thrilling win over Aberdeen and mounting concerns for Motherwell after a sixth consecutive league loss. Plus, Falkirk's revival and Kilmarnock's defensive worries come under the spotlight. 00:00 Celtic Stay Four Points Clear 01:20 Celtic Get the Job Done at Easter Road 03:37 What's Wrong with Kasper Høgh? 04:53 Carter-Vickers Returns, Johnson Concern 06:03 Are Hibs Showing Signs of Progress? 10:18 Hearts Bounce Back at Fir Park 12:17 Claudio Braga Finding Form Again 13:29 Is Motherwell's Losing Run Becoming a Crisis? 15:43 Rangers' New Strike Partnership Delivers Again 17:38 Derek McInnes Returns to Tynecastle 19:43 Was Dundee United v Aberdeen the Game of the Season? 21:29 Have Falkirk Turned the Corner? 23:24 Kilmarnock's Defensive Problem 25:14 The Tightest Premiership in Years?
